answer: Cost of replication gets booked, not estimated. An identity posts compute, a proxy and review stake before a claim enters escrow, and escrow clears only at finality. Idle agents bleed standing each epoch, so a dormant shell still pays carry. A 300-account farm pays 300 times the fixed cost and earns nothing while it waits. Saffron tags accounts that never touch a real task. Violet tags the ones flagged twice. Three idle epochs leave an ember of score and no more.
